qe: Which university, established in 1917, is the oldest university of Bihar?
qh: 1917 में स्थापित बिहार का सबसे पुराना विश्वविद्यालय कौन-सा है?
oh: बाबा साहेब भीमराव अंबेडकर बिहार विश्वविद्यालय
e: Patna University ki sthapna 1917 me hui tatha yah Bihar ka sabse purana vishwavidyalaya hai; yah bharat ke sabse purane vishwavidyalayaon me bhi gina jaata hai (Calcutta, Bombay, Madras tatha Allahabad ke baad ki pankti me). Us samay Patna Bihar tatha Orissa prant ki rajdhani thi tatha uchch shiksha ke sabhi kendra ek hi vishwavidyalaya ke adheen the, isliye ise 'unitary' (ek hi Parisar me padhai) vishwavidyalaya ke roop me vikasit kiya gaya. Iske antargat Patna College, Patna Science College tatha anya mahatvapurn college aate hain tatha 1916 me bane Patna High Court ke saath-saath yah shahar vidhik tatha shiksha dono ka kendra ban gaya. Nalanda Vishwavidyalaya ek prachin sansthan tha, tatha Nalanda ke prachin mahavihara ka itihas bahut purana hai, lekin aaj ka 'Nalanda University' 21vein sadi me punah sthapit hua; Magadh tatha Babasaheb Ambedkar Bihar University baad ke dashakon me bane. Isliye sahi uttar 'Patna University' hai. Exam point: Bihar ka sabse purana vishwavidyalaya = Patna University (1917); prachin Nalanda Mahavihara (Kumargupta I, 5vein sadi) tatha aaj ka Nalanda University (2014) alag hain.

qe: The revived Nalanda University, an international university at Rajgir, began its first academic session in which year?
qh: राजगीर में स्थित अंतर्राष्ट्रीय विश्वविद्यालय, पुनर्जीवित नालंदा विश्वविद्यालय का पहला शैक्षणिक सत्र किस वर्ष शुरू हुआ?
e: Prachin Nalanda Mahavihara duniya ka pehla bada avasiya antarrashtriya vishwavidyalaya maana jaata hai, jise 1193 ee. ke aas-paas Bakhtiyar Khalji ne ujjar diya tha. Aadhunik samay me 2010 me sansad ne Nalanda University Act pass kiya tatha 2014 me Rajgir (Nalanda jila) me iska pahila shaikshanik satra shuru hua, isliye yah punarjeevit vishwavidyalaya 21vein sadi ki mahatvapurn pahal hai. Yah vishwavidyalaya mukhya roop se antarrashtriya chhatraon tatha paddhatiyon (jaise Buddhist studies, environment, historical studies) par zor deta hai tatha kai deshon ne iske nirmaan me sahayog diya, jisme China, Japan, Singapore tatha anya desh shaamil hain. Iska campus Rajgir ke paas vikasit kiya gaya hai, taaki prachin mahavihara tatha Buddhist kshetra ka mahatva bahaal rahe. 1917 Patna University ka varsh hai, 2008 me IIT Patna shuru hua tatha 2020 is vishwavidyalaya ke liye koi sthapna-varsh nahi hai, isliye sahi uttar 2014 hai. Exam point: Nalanda University (aadhunik, punarjeevit) = Nalanda University Act 2010, pahla satra 2014 me Rajgir (Nalanda) me; prachin Nalanda Mahavihara UNESCO site tatha Kumargupta I se juda.

qe: Which prestigious engineering institute of Patna was originally established in 1886 as the Bihar School of Engineering?
qh: पटना का कौन-सा प्रतिष्ठित अभियांत्रिकी संस्थान मूल रूप से 1886 में बिहार स्कूल ऑफ इंजीनियरिंग के रूप में स्थापित किया गया था?
e: NIT Patna ka purana naam tatha itihas bahut mahatvapurn hai - 1886 me yah 'Bihar School of Engineering' ke roop me shuru hua tatha aage chal kar 'Bihar College of Engineering' tatha phir 'National Institute of Technology (NIT) Patna' ke roop me vikasit hua. NIT bharat ke una chune hue sansthanon me aate hain jahan engineering ki uchch shiksha tatha anusandhan hota hai tatha unme JEE Main ke aadhaar par chhatra chune jaate hain; NIT Patna ka campus Patna me Ganga kinare ke paas hai. IIT Patna 2008 me Bihar me IIT sthapit hone ke baad shuru hua tatha BIT Patna ek niji sansthan hai; Patna Science College 1917 me bane Patna University ka hissa hai. Isliye 1886 me Bihar School of Engineering ke naam se shuru hone wala sansthan NIT Patna hi hai. Exam point: NIT Patna = 1886 me 'Bihar School of Engineering' ke roop me sthapit; IIT Patna 2008 me shuru; Patna Science College Patna University (1917) se juda.

qe: AIIMS Patna, a premier medical institute of Bihar set up under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana, became operational in which year?
qh: प्रधानमंत्री स्वास्थ्य सुरक्षा योजना के तहत स्थापित बिहार का प्रमुख चिकित्सा संस्थान एम्स पटना किस वर्ष कार्यरत हुआ?
e: AIIMS Patna (All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Patna) kendriya sarkar ki 'Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana' (PMSSY) ke tehat banaya gaya tatha iska kaam 2012 ke aas-paas shuru hua; yah Bihar ke sabse bade sarkari chikitsa tatha medical-shiksha sansthanon me gina jaata hai. AIIMS ka mukhya uddeshya yah hai ki desh ke alag-alag kshetraon me sabse uncha star ka aspatal tatha medical college ho, taaki log ek jagah par ikatthe na hon tatha ilaaj apne hi kshetra me mil sake; yahan MBBS, nursing tatha anya courses bhi padhaaye jaate hain. AIIMS Patna me super-speciality (dil, cancer, neuro tatha anya) ke vibhag sthit hain tatha aadhunik jaanch-upchar ki suvidha hai. Isi tarah ke anya sansthan jaise IIT Patna 2008 me tatha Nalanda University 2014 me shuru hue, jabki AIIMS ka karyarambh 2012 ke aas-paas hua, isliye 2012 sahi uttar hai. Exam point: AIIMS Patna = PMSSY ke tehat 2012 me karyarambh; yah Bihar ka pramukh kendra-sarkar chikitsa tatha medical-shiksha sansthan hai; IIT Patna 2008 tatha Nalanda University pahla satra 2014.

qe: Which is the oldest medical college of Bihar, established in 1925 as the Prince of Wales Medical College?
qh: 1925 में प्रिंस ऑफ वेल्स मेडिकल कॉलेज के रूप में स्थापित बिहार का सबसे पुराना मेडिकल कॉलेज कौन-सा है?
e: Patna Medical College and Hospital (PMCH) Bihar ka sabse purana medical college hai; ise 1925 me 'Prince of Wales Medical College' ke naam se shuru kiya gaya tha tatha azaadi ke baad iska naam badal kar PMCH kar diya gaya. Us samay yah poore Bihar tatha Orissa prant ke chhatraon ke liye medical shiksha ka ekmatra bada kendra tha, isliye yahan se padhe hue doctor poore desh me seva karne lage. Aaj bhi PMCH Bihar ke sabse bade sarkari aspatalon me hai, jahan hazaron marij roz ilaaj ke liye aate hain; isi campus me nursing tatha anya courses bhi chalte hain tatha ise 'upgradation' yojna ke tehat aur vikasit kiya ja raha hai. Nalanda Medical College, Darbhanga Medical College tatha Anugrah Narayan Magadh Medical College (Gaya) baad ke dashakon me bane, isliye 'PMCH' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: PMCH = Bihar ka sabse purana medical college, 1925 me 'Prince of Wales Medical College' ke naam se sthapit; yah Bihar ka ek pramukh sarkari aspatal tatha chikitsa-shiksha kendra hai.

qe: Aryabhatta Knowledge University, set up to affiliate technical and medical institutions, is headquartered at which place?
qh: तकनीकी तथा चिकित्सा संस्थानों को संबद्ध करने के लिए स्थापित आर्यभट्ट ज्ञान विश्वविद्यालय का मुख्यालय कहाँ है?
e: Aryabhatta Knowledge University (AKU) 2010 me sthapit hui tatha iska mukhyalay Patna me hai; yah rajya ke engineering, pharmacy, nursing, medical tatha anya professional yah un sansthanon ko sanbaddh (affiliate) karti hai tatha unke pathyakram tatha parikshaon ki nigrani karti hai. Iska naam mahan ganitagya tatha khagol-vigyan ke vidwan Aryabhata ke naam par rakha gaya hai, jinke baare me kaha jaata hai ki unhone Kusumapura (aaj ka Patna) me rah kar 'Aryabhatiya' (499 ee.) likhi. Is vishwavidyalaya ke kaam me technical tatha medical education ke manak (standard) banaye rakhna tatha chhatra-sankhya badhane ke saath gunvatta banaaye rakhna shaamil hai. Gaya me Central University of South Bihar tatha Magadh University, Muzaffarpur me Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Bihar University tatha Bhagalpur me Tilka Manjhi Bhagalpur University sthit hai, isliye AKU ke liye 'Patna' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Aryabhatta Knowledge University = mukhyalay Patna, 2010 me sthapit, technical tatha medical sansthanon ki affiliating university; Aryabhata ne Kusumapura (Patna) me Aryabhatiya likhi.

qe: Mukhyamantri Balak-Balika Cycle Yojana of Bihar was launched mainly to:
qh: बिहार की मुख्यमंत्री बालक-बालिका साइकिल योजना मुख्यतः किस उद्देश्य से शुरू की गई?
oe: Encourage students, especially girls, to continue secondary education by providing bicycles
Provide free cooking gas connections to poor families
Give free smartphones to students for online classes
Provide free cycles to health workers for field visits
oh: माध्यमिक शिक्षा जारी रखने के लिए छात्रों, विशेषकर छात्राओं को साइकिल देकर प्रोत्साहित करना
गरीब परिवारों को मुफ्त रसोई गैस कनेक्शन
ऑनलाइन कक्षाओं के लिए छात्रों को मुफ्त स्मार्टफोन
स्वास्थ्य कर्मियों को क्षेत्र-भ्रमण हेतु मुफ्त साइकिल
e: Bihar me pehle ladkiyon ka school chhod dena ek badi samasya thi, kyunki gaon se madhyamik (secondary) school door hone par aane-jaane ka kharch tatha suraksha ki chinta maa-baap ko rok deti thi. Isi samasya ko dekhkar Bihar sarkar ne Mukhyamantri Balak-Balika Cycle Yojana shuru ki, jisme kaksha 9 me padhne wale chhatraon (vishesh roop se chhatraon tatha chhaatraon) ko cycle di jaati hai, taaki woh door wale school tak aasani se pahunch sakein. Is yojana ka asar yah hua ki 9ve-10ve me ladkiyon ka enrollment tatha thehraav (retention) badha; iske saath 'Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana' jaisi yojnayein bhi chalti hain, jisme intermediate tatha graduation karne wali chhatraon ko protsahan rashi milti hai. Free gas connection (Ujjwala), smartphone yojna tatha health-worker cycle jaisi yojnayein alag uddeshyon ke liye hain, isliye sahi uttar cycle-tatha-shiksha wala hai. Exam point: Mukhyamantri Balak-Balika Cycle Yojana = madhyamik shiksha me thehraav tatha ladkiyon ki padhai badhane ke liye cycle; isi tarah Kanya Utthan Yojana ladkiyon ki uchch shiksha ko protsahit karta hai.

qe: Which central university of Bihar has its main campus at Gaya?
qh: बिहार का कौन-सा केंद्रीय विश्वविद्यालय अपने मुख्य परिसर के साथ गया में स्थित है?
e: Bihar ka kendriya vishwavidyalaya 'Central University of South Bihar' (CUSB) hai tatha iska mukhya parisar Gaya jile me sthit hai; yah kendriya vishwavidyalaya adhiniyam ke tehat banaya gaya tatha kuch samay tak iska naam 'Central University of Bihar' ke roop me bhi istemal hua. Kendriya vishwavidyalaya kendra sarkar dwara paise tatha sanchalit hote hain tatha unme rashtriya mahatva ke pathyakram chalte hain; CUSB me vigyan, samaj-vigyan, bhasha tatha anya vishyon me padhai tatha anusandhan hota hai. Gaya kshetra me Magadh University bhi hai tatha Bodh Gaya ke paas prachin gyan-parampara ka mahatva hai, isliye yahan vishwavidyalaya ka hona aitihasik drishti se mahatvapurn hai. Nalanda University Rajgir (Nalanda) me hai tatha Mahatma Gandhi Central University Bihar me nahi (MG Central University Bihar ke Motihari me hai, lekin yah prashn CUSB ke Gaya parisar ka hai) - isliye sahi uttar Central University of South Bihar hai. Exam point: Bihar ka kendriya vishwavidyalaya = Central University of South Bihar, mukhya parisar Gaya; Nalanda University Rajgir (Nalanda) me; Bihar me ek anya kendriya vishwavidyalaya Mahatma Gandhi Central University (Motihari) bhi hai.
